Definition: reddish (of the hair or the complexion)
BiblicalUsage: Admoniy means reddish — of hair or complexion. Esau came out red all over, like a hairy garment, and the name Edom grew from it; David was ruddy, with a beautiful countenance, when Samuel came to anoint him; and Goliath looked at the boy and disdained him, because he was but a youth, and ruddy.
TheologicalSignificance: A word this rare cannot carry a theme by itself; what it offers is a clear detail inside a verse that does the real teaching; in this case, the verse is Genesis 25:25.
